statements.text: Resting is added to `src/screens/camp.tsx`, and no new screen is registered for it.
The camp shows that resting costs 20 gold before the player rests.
Resting calls the game's `rest`, and the screen changes no gold, HP or MP itself.
After resting, the screen tells the player the party has rested.
With 5 gold, resting is shown as not possible, or says it needs 20 gold, rather than being offered as if it would work.
Choosing to rest without enough gold doesn't rest the party and tells the player why.
statements.note: `rest` in state.ts already refuses and returns `{ ok: false, reason: 'gold' }`. Calling it and showing nothing when it is refused fails this.
